scope: Numerical reproducibility and model-to-project compatibility, not biological validation.

dosing.washoutAudit: The positive post-input population is built into logistic growth plus recycling. A washout half-life does not imply clearance when reproduction continues.
dosing.recommendedWikiUse: Qualitative transport / secretion / sensitivity framework only; assumptions must remain visible.
doNotPresentAsEvidence: 89.3 nM is an internally defined model threshold, not a measured remission concentration.
3e10 CFU/day and other human dosing suggestions are unsupported clinical recommendations.
LHS success fraction quantifies the selected parameter prior, not a patient response rate or validated robustness.
Parameters tagged L have descriptive comments but no exact supporting source next to each estimate.
The 09 PD block is an uncalibrated mutually repressive abstraction, not measured Elafin–NE kinetics.

ros.recommendedWikiUse: A qualitative sensing / diffusion hypothesis only; do not relabel an AND-gated payload as current PspA support.
ros.architectureMismatch: PoxyS x pPepT AND -> effector in source; current project uses ROS -> proposed PspA support plus constitutive Elafin.
caveats: Healthy/IBD/severe parameter sets and layers are assumed; no individual-level fitting or uncertainty calibration was found.
PoxyS half activation, Hill exponent and basal expression lack an exact calibration data source.
Rate comments group production and first-order consumption under one unit; consumption multiplied by concentration requires inverse-time units.
EcN placement at the epithelium is assumed rather than measured.

ode.finding: The source calls parameters CALIBRATED but immediately says Designed to produce desired steady states. No observation-to-parameter fit or held-out validation is present.
ode.recommendedWikiUse: Archive as an earlier abstraction and explain why it does not establish therapeutic bistability.

evidence: IBD-Engineered-Bacteria/ROADMAP_NEXT.md line 13 lists iHMP multiomics as not started.

File and content inspection found dosing simulations, host gene expression, GWAS and FBA tables, but no measured microbial abundance matrix, co-culture trajectory or inferred ecological interaction coefficients.
microbiome.added: ecology_scenarios.py and ecology-scenarios.json provide an explicitly uncalibrated alternative.
microbiome.claim: Exploratory interaction scenario, not inferred microbiome interactions.

pathConventions.submission-root: Submitted Elafin-IBD research project root, containing data and 08_clinical_genetics. Paths are relative to this root; local user directories are omitted.
pathConventions.wiki-root: The wiki repository root. Published audit copies preserve source-relative paths; original submitted files remain unchanged.
